name: Quillsy AI Content Generator
author: nomijan

sections.description:
Quillsy AI Content Generator turns one keyword into a fully published WordPress article — written by AI and illustrated with an auto-generated featured image. All in under 60 seconds. Unlimited articles, free forever.

Powered by Groq (Llama 3.3 — 100% free, no credit card needed), Google Gemini, or OpenAI — your choice. Image generation via Pollinations or Pixabay. The free version lets bloggers, content creators, and small businesses automate their entire publishing pipeline at zero cost, with no usage limits.

⚡ Why this plugin

Most AI plugins lock you into one provider that may not work in your country, may require a credit card, or may slow down. Quillsy AI Content Generator gives you 3 AI engines to pick from in one click — including Groq, which is genuinely free with no credit card required.

🚀 Free Lite Features

  • AI Article Writing — Generate 800-1500 word SEO-optimized blog posts from a single keyword
  • 3 FREE AI engines included — Groq (Llama 3.3, no credit card needed), Google Gemini, or OpenAI (your own key) — pick whichever works for you
  • 35 Languages Supported — English, Spanish, French, German, Hindi, Urdu, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, and 26 more
  • AI Image Generation — Auto-create a featured image. Pick Pollinations (free AI-generated, no key) OR Pixabay (free stock photos, instant signup)
  • Draft or Publish — Review before publishing, or set to auto-publish immediately
  • Clean Admin UI — SaaS-style dashboard, monthly usage tracker, no clutter
  • Privacy Friendly — All generation happens via your chosen API. No data sold or tracked.

📊 Lite vs Pro

The Lite version gives you a real, working AI publishing engine — perfect for personal blogs and small content sites.

For unlimited articles, 8-platform social auto-posting (Twitter, Pinterest, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Threads, YouTube Shorts), AI Caption Rewriter, Auto-Republish for old posts, WooCommerce bulk product descriptions, Google Indexing API, AI Quality Scoring, and 5 advanced image providers (Cloudflare FLUX, gpt-image-1, DALL-E, Nano Banana, Pexels) — upgrade to WP Auto Agent Pro at wpautoagent.com.

🔑 Requirements

You need ONE of these free AI provider keys:

  • Groq (recommended — 100% FREE, no credit card needed) — Sign up at console.groq.com/keys. Free tier: 14,400 requests/day with Llama 3.3.
  • Google Gemini — Get a key at aistudio.google.com. Free tier: limited daily quota.
  • OpenAI — Get a key at platform.openai.com/api-keys. Pay-as-you-go (~$0.001 per article with gpt-4o-mini).

💼 Who is this for?

  • Solo bloggers who want consistent publishing without the writing time
  • Niche site owners filling content gaps in 35 languages
  • Small businesses that need a steady blog but lack a writer
  • Anyone wanting to test AI publishing before committing to a paid plugin

🌍 35 Supported Languages

English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Malay, Filipino, Swahili, Greek, Czech, Hungarian, Swedish, Danish.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to generate articles and images. By using the plugin, you agree to the terms of these services.

Groq API (default, recommended) — used to generate article content via Llama 3.3 when “Groq” is selected as the AI provider.
* When: every time you click “Generate Article”
* What is sent: the keyword you entered, language preference, and our standard prompt template
* Service Provider Terms: https://groq.com/terms-of-use/
* Privacy Policy: https://groq.com/privacy-policy/

Google Gemini API — used to generate article content when “Gemini” is selected as the AI provider.
* When: every time you click “Generate Article” with Gemini selected
* What is sent: the keyword you entered, language preference, and our standard prompt template
* Service Provider Terms: https://ai.google.dev/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

OpenAI API — used to generate article content when “OpenAI” is selected as the AI provider.
* When: every time you click “Generate Article” with OpenAI selected
* What is sent: the keyword you entered, language preference, and our standard prompt template
* Service Provider Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
* Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

Pollinations AI (default image option) — used to generate the featured image when “Pollinations” is selected.
* When: every time an article is generated with Pollinations selected
* What is sent: the keyword you entered (used as image prompt)
* Service Provider Terms: https://pollinations.ai/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://pollinations.ai/privacy

Pixabay API — used to fetch a stock featured image when “Pixabay” is selected as the image provider.
* When: every time an article is generated with Pixabay selected
* What is sent: the keyword you entered (as the search query)
* Service Provider Terms: https://pixabay.com/service/terms/
* Privacy Policy: https://pixabay.com/service/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/quillsy-ai-content-generator/ directory, or install through the WordPress plugin screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Get a free Gemini API key at aistudio.google.com/app/apikey.
  4. Go to Auto Agent → Settings, paste your Gemini key, choose your default language, optionally connect ONE social platform.
  5. Go to Auto Agent → Generate, enter a keyword, click Generate. Done!
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay for AI?

No. Quillsy AI Content Generator gives you 3 AI provider options. Groq (Llama 3.3) is 100% free with no credit card required — sign up with email at console.groq.com and get 14,400 free requests/day. Google Gemini also has a free tier. OpenAI is pay-as-you-go (~$0.001 per article). Image generation via Pollinations is also free.

How is the article quality?

Articles are generated by your chosen engine. Groq’s Llama 3.3 70B and Gemini 1.5/2.0 Flash are both high-quality, comparable to GPT-4 for blog writing. Output is comparable to a freelance writer’s first draft. We recommend reviewing in Draft mode before publishing.

Will Google penalize AI-written content?

No. Google’s official policy (March 2024) explicitly accepts AI-generated content if it’s helpful, original, and people-first. The Lite version produces articles that meet these criteria.

Can I use this on multiple sites?

Yes — the free version is GPL-licensed and can be installed on any number of WordPress sites with no usage caps.

Does this work with my caching plugin?

Yes — fully compatible with WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, W3 Total Cache, and Cloudflare CDN.

Can I edit the article before it publishes?

Yes. Set “Save as: Draft” when generating. The article saves to your WordPress drafts queue ready for editing before going live.

Where is my data stored?

Everything stays in your WordPress database. The plugin sends prompts to Google Gemini’s API for article generation, but no user data is sold, tracked, or shared.

How do I uninstall cleanly?

Deleting the plugin removes all settings and counters automatically via the included uninstall.php.

My Groq / OpenAI / Gemini key isn’t working. What now?

Click the “🔌 Test Active Provider” button on the Settings page. The test result tells you exactly what’s wrong — invalid key, billing not set up, model not available, or network blocked. Most issues are fixed by regenerating the key from the provider’s dashboard.

Can I switch AI providers anytime?

Yes. Save keys for any/all of Groq, Gemini, OpenAI in Settings, then click the provider card you want active. The switch is instant — next article uses the new provider.

Does the plugin send my data anywhere I don’t know about?

No. The plugin only sends your keyword + language to whichever AI/image provider you’ve configured (and only then). Nothing is sent to the plugin author. See the “External Services” section below for the full disclosure.

Will the free version stop working if I don’t upgrade?

No. Quillsy AI Content Generator is fully GPL-licensed free software. You can use it indefinitely with no usage limits. Pro is optional and only adds advanced features (additional image engines, multi-platform social posting, auto-republish, etc.).
